booking.question: How do I book a safari?
booking.answer: Simply contact us through WhatsApp, phone, email or our contact form. Our travel consultants will discuss your plans and help create the perfect safari for you.

customize.question: Can I customize my safari?
customize.answer: Absolutely. Our safaris are tailor-made around your interests, budget, travel dates and preferred destinations. We can customize accommodation, activities, transport and itinerary.

countries.question: Which African countries do you operate in?
countries.answer: We arrange unforgettable journeys across Africa, including Kenya, Tanzania, Uganda, Rwanda, Botswana, Zimbabwe, Namibia, South Africa, Egypt, Morocco and other destinations.

privateGroup.question: Are your safaris private or group trips?
privateGroup.answer: We offer both private and group safaris. Whether you're traveling solo, as a couple, with family, friends or a larger group, we can create an experience that suits you.

transport.question: Do you provide airport transfers and transportation?
transport.answer: Yes. Depending on your itinerary, we can arrange airport transfers, private safari vehicles, tour vans and other transportation needed throughout your journey.

bestTime.question: What is the best time to go on safari?
bestTime.answer: The best time depends on your destination and the experience you want. Our travel consultants can recommend the ideal season based on wildlife, weather, migration, gorilla trekking or beach experiences.

accommodation.question: Do you arrange accommodation?
accommodation.answer: Yes. We carefully select lodges, hotels, tented camps and resorts based on your itinerary, preferences and budget to make your stay comfortable and memorable.

honeymoon.question: Can you arrange honeymoons and special occasions?
honeymoon.answer: Yes. We create romantic and personalized journeys for honeymoons, anniversaries, birthdays and other special occasions, including luxury safari and beach combinations.

service.heading: Experiences Designed
service.description: Curious Safaris specializes in private, customized, and unforgettable journeys across Africa. From wildlife encounters and luxury safaris to cultural expeditions and beach escapes, every itinerary is designed around your interests.

wildlife.title: Wildlife Safaris
wildlife.description: Africa's wildlife is unlike anything else in the world. Our wildlife safaris take you deep into legendary destinations such as the Maasai Mara, Serengeti, Amboseli, Samburu, Kruger National Park, and the Okavango Delta.
wildlife.details: Track the Big Five, witness the Great Migration, enjoy sunrise and sunset game drives, and explore protected ecosystems with experienced guides who understand wildlife behavior and conservation.

luxury.title: Luxury & Mid-Range Tours
luxury.description: Whether you prefer five-star luxury or a carefully planned mid-range adventure, we create experiences that balance comfort, authenticity, and exploration.
luxury.details: Stay in luxury lodges, boutique hotels, private camps, or carefully selected accommodations while enjoying personalized service, exclusive activities, and seamless travel planning.

photography.title: Photography Expeditions
photography.description: Designed for photographers and nature enthusiasts, our photography expeditions provide access to extraordinary landscapes, wildlife, and cultural experiences across Africa.
photography.details: Capture mountain gorillas in Uganda, the Great Migration in Tanzania, the Namib Desert, Victoria Falls, and Africa's most spectacular wildlife moments.

horseRiding.title: Horse-Riding Safaris
horseRiding.description: Experience Africa beyond traditional game drives through unique horseback adventures that bring you closer to nature.
horseRiding.details: Ride across open plains, discover hidden landscapes, and enjoy immersive experiences that combine adventure, freedom, and unforgettable scenery.

cultural.title: Cultural Experiences
cultural.description: Travel is about more than wildlife. Our cultural journeys introduce you to Africa's people, traditions, music, cuisine, and heritage.
cultural.details: Visit local communities, explore ancient cities, experience traditional ceremonies, and connect with cultures across East, West, North, Central, and Southern Africa.

beach.title: Beach Holidays & Tailor-Made Adventures
beach.description: Relax along Africa's spectacular coastlines or create a completely personalized itinerary designed specifically for you.
beach.details: From Zanzibar and the Kenyan coast to Morocco and South Africa, we combine beaches, safaris, culture, and adventure into one seamless experience.

regions.title: Africa Without
regions.description: Curious Safaris creates unforgettable journeys across East, Southern, North, West, and Central Africa. From world-famous wildlife destinations and pristine coastlines to ancient civilizations and vibrant cultures, we help travelers experience Africa without limitations.

eastAfrica.title: East Africa
eastAfrica.highlights: Maasai Mara • Serengeti • Amboseli • Gorilla Trekking
eastAfrica.description: East Africa is home to some of the world's most iconic safari destinations. Witness the Great Migration across the Serengeti and Maasai Mara, track endangered mountain gorillas in Uganda and Rwanda, explore the vast plains of Amboseli beneath Mount Kilimanjaro, and discover an incredible diversity of wildlife, landscapes, and cultures.

southernAfrica.title: Southern Africa
southernAfrica.highlights: Victoria Falls • Okavango Delta • Namib Desert
southernAfrica.description: Southern Africa offers extraordinary landscapes and some of the continent's most luxurious safari experiences. Cruise through the waterways of the Okavango Delta, stand before the breathtaking Victoria Falls, explore the dramatic dunes of Namibia, and experience world-class wildlife encounters in South Africa and Botswana.

northAfrica.title: North Africa
northAfrica.highlights: The Pyramids • The Sahara • Imperial Cities
northAfrica.description: North Africa combines ancient history with rich cultural experiences. Explore the pyramids of Egypt, wander through Morocco's historic medinas, discover centuries-old traditions, and experience the spectacular beauty of the Sahara Desert.

centralAfrica.title: Central Africa
centralAfrica.description: Central Africa reveals a different side of the continent. Dense rainforests, rare wildlife, extraordinary biodiversity, and authentic cultural encounters create unforgettable experiences for adventurous travelers seeking something beyond traditional safari routes.

westAfrica.title: West Africa
westAfrica.description: West Africa offers a fascinating combination of history, music, culture, and heritage. Explore historical landmarks, vibrant cities, traditional communities, and coastal destinations while discovering one of Africa's most culturally diverse regions.
